title: TRUNK-6646: Env-var key normalization drops create_database_* / create_user_* credentials in scripted setup
body:
<!--- Add a pull request title above in this format -->
<!--- real example: 'TRUNK-5111: Replace use of deprecated isVoided' -->
<!--- 'TRUNK-JiraIssueNumber: JiraIssueTitle' -->
## Description of what I changed
<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->
<!--- It can simply be your commit message, which you must have -->
I  expanded NON_NORMALIZED_KEYS: By adding the following keys to the allow list to prevent incorrect normalization (preserving underscores):
       * CONNECTION_DRIVER_CLASS
       * CREATE_DATABASE_USERNAME
       * CREATE_DATABASE_PASSWORD
       * CREATE_USER_USERNAME
       * CREATE_USER_PASSWORD
  Also I updated the initializeWizardFromResolvedPropertiesIfPresent method to resolve the database driver from both connection.driver_class (dot notation) and connection_driver_class (underscore notation). This ensures compatibility regardless of whether the value comes from a runtime properties file or a normalized environment variable.
